title: feat(spec, platform-objects): declare features.cloudManaged with a hide-when-on gate, and hide the six doors that add people while it is on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg5aqQYL47sTxfs8Z3JjcGfv)_

Fixes #25292
Fixes #25295
Part of #25083

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

The console flag `features.cloudManaged` for the managed (cloud-hosted, SSO-only) mode, built as one trunk under ruling `6352436010` on #25292 (letter A, the cross-domain exception path): the spec entry, the six platform-objects predicates and plugin-auth's served line are held equal by three pins, so they land in one commit. The governing ruling for the flag itself is `6341690661` on #25083, Q3 A (and Q4 A for `set_user_password`).

## Spec half (#25292)

- `PublicAuthFeatureSemantics` gains `'hide-when-on'`: the flag being ON hides the input. `featureGatePredicate` lowers it to `features.X != true`. The function now reads a total map over the semantics, so a fourth semantics fails to compile instead of taking another arm's operator.
- `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.cloudManaged` (`surface: 'crud'`, `semantics: 'hide-when-on'`) books six gated inputs: `invite_user` on `sys_user`, `sys_member`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_organization`; `sys_user.actions.create_user`; `sys_user.actions.set_user_password`. Through `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES`, `requiresFeature: 'cloudManaged'` is now accepted and lowers to `features.cloudManaged != true` (this is the `Metadata-protocol: added`).
- `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.cloudManaged: z.boolean().optional()`, the form of the newest siblings (`ssoEnforced`, `phoneNumber`, `phoneNumberOtp`).
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/{api/auth-endpoints,ui/action}.mdx`, one line of `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (`check:generated --fix` proved only `check:docs` stale; `api-surface` unchanged). `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` names the third lowering.

## Engine half (#25295)

- Each of the six actions keeps its `requiresFeature` (`organization` x4, `admin` x2) and gains `features.cloudManaged != true` written in `visible`, since `requiresFeature` names one flag. Lowered, e.g. `(current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true && features.cloudManaged != true) && features.admin == true`.
- `set_user_password` is hidden in the console only; no server-side refusal here (the server keeps answering it on an `env_native` row).
- `feature-gate-guard.test.ts`: the forward rows now ask whether the flag's gate is one of the predicate's `&&` conjuncts. Parentheses that only group conjuncts are transparent; a gate under `||`, `!` or `?:` is not a gate; no substring match. Every row accepted before is accepted unchanged. Pinned in the same file: accepted `gate`, `(a) && gate`, `(a && gate) && b` and the invite shape; refused `a || gate`, `a || b && gate`, `!(gate)`, `a ? gate : true`, a longer token, and the gate inside a string literal.
- `identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts` evaluates the six lowered predicates through `@objectstack/formula`'s `celEngine`: hidden with `cloudManaged: true`, offered with `false`, and still hidden when its other flag is off.
- Byte pins updated for the new predicates: `platform-objects.test.ts` (lowering matrix), `invite-entry-toolbar.test.ts` (the mirrors agree); `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts` serves `cloudManaged: false` beside the other flags.

## Services line (part of #25083)

- `getPublicConfig()`'s `features` literal (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`) gains exactly one line, `cloudManaged: isCloudManaged()`, with `isCloudManaged` added to the existing `@objectstack/core` import. It reads the one accessor #25294 landed, so the console's hide-when-on gate and every server-side managed-mode judgement read the same answer. Everything else of #25083's services half stays on its own claim.
- `auth-manager.test.ts`: the exact-match payload test lists `cloudManaged: false` (`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` unset), and a new case sets `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`, resets the memoized verdict with `resetCloudManagedForTesting()`, reads `true`, and restores the environment.

## Verification (head `72cea5b1`)

- `main` merged in (no rebase) after #25294 landed as `db1c7ccad`.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `check:generated` reports all 14 generated artifacts up to date after rebuilding spec on the merged tree. Spec suite on `d30caab4`: 783 files, 22794 passed, 1 todo; `typecheck` 0.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: full `vitest run` on `91d3cd6b` was 186/187 files, the one red being the exact-match payload test missing `cloudManaged` (fixed in `72cea5b1`); on `72cea5b1` `auth-manager.test.ts` + `public-feature-registry.test.ts` 302/302 passed, so the registry drift guard is green; `typecheck` 0.
- Reverse verification of the served line: replacing `cloudManaged: isCloudManaged()` with `cloudManaged: false` on disk reds `serves features.cloudManaged from OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` (1 failed); file restored from a copy, `git diff` empty.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `vitest run` 88 files, 1318 passed; `typecheck` 0.
- Reverse verification of the guard, both legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob each time: deleting the authored gate from `sys_member.invite_user` reds `sys_member.actions.invite_user is gated on cloudManaged` (1 failed / 100 passed); replacing it with `true || features.cloudManaged != true` reds the same row (1 failed / 101 passed).
- Before this branch's engine half, the spec half alone on the base reds 6 forward rows in the guard and 2 plugin-auth registry cases (measured, dependency closure built).
- Derived gates on `72cea5b1`: `dispatch-gates --commands` lists 117; 116 exit 0; 1 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, left to CI): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone cannot read its pinned fixture commit). `--ran` reconciles 117 derived, 116 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- CI on `72cea5b1`: 36 check runs success, 6 skipped, none red (Test Core 1–6, Build Core, Build Docs, every Lint and Type Check lane, and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`).

## Acceptance notes

- The spec comments say an absent `default-on` flag "fails open". In `@objectstack/formula`'s `celEngine` an absent key faults (`No such key`) for every flag, `default-on` included, so the answer for a payload that omits a flag is the consumer's fault handling. Not changed here; plugin-auth's drift guard keeps the served key set stable, so a current server never omits one.
- A Clause-② `(narrowing)` was looked for and not found: the six actions only hide where the server serves `cloudManaged: true`, which happens only on a runtime with `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` (the cloud-hosted one, whose people arrive through the identity provider); every other deployment serves `false` and sees no change.

Changesets: `@objectstack/spec` minor (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`); `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`); `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`).

Review: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (schema face) by the `domain:spec` seat; the `domain:engine` seat posts one PASS/FAIL line on the platform-objects hunks. #25294 is on `main`; draft until the maintainer has confirmed ruling `6352436010`.
